read.thesis: Deere says 2026 is the ag cycle bottom with channel inventory lean: high-HP tractor inventory down nearly 40% YoY, PPA sales guided down ~10% but margin 11-12%, C&F up ~20% with backlogs into FY27.

utilisation.quote: we have proactively adjusted production levels and are modestly underproducing retail demand in the region

triggers.label: PPA and C&F underproducing retail
triggers.quote: modest under production this year. Call it a couple percentage points for each of these segments

triggers.label: High-HP tractor inventory down ~40% YoY
triggers.quote: model year 2023 and 2024 high horsepower tractors are down nearly 40% from a year ago

triggers.label: Net income guide raised to $4.75-5.0B
triggers.quote: we improved our net income outlook raising it to a range of 4.75 to 5 billion

triggers.label: C&F price realization +8 pts in Q3
triggers.quote: Price realization was positive by 8 points

triggers.label: Planter and sprayer EOP up mid-single digits
triggers.quote: results are up mid single digits compared to the completion of last year's program

triggers.label: Net tariff cost steps up to ~$1B in FY27
triggers.quote: Going into next year, we would expect a run rate that is going to be closer to, or right around 1 billion for the year

guidance.quote: we improved our net income outlook raising it to a range of 4.75 to 5 billion
cash flow expectations from the equipment operation have also improved. To now be in the range of 5 to 5.5 billion
now expect net sales to be down approximately 10% for the year
Our full year forecast for the segment's operating margin has been narrowed, and is now between 11-12%
The segment's operating margin guide has been increased to between 14.5-15.5%
The 2026 net sales forecast remained steady at up approximately 20% for the full year.
we now expect direct tariff expense of approximately 1.1 billion for the fiscal year
For fiscal year 26, our full year outlook has increased to $870 million.

red_flags.label: Net tariff exposure rises to ~$1B in FY27
red_flags.quote: Going into next year, we would expect a run rate that is going to be closer to, or right around 1 billion for the year

red_flags.label: C&F order bank 4-5 months, above preferred 2-3
red_flags.quote: We have about 4 to 5 months of orders on hand, which is, quite frankly, a little more than we would want to have

evasions.quote: I think it is too early to tell. As you know, specifically in South America, things can turn quickly.
nothing outsized there from a pricing perspective
